g.title: These are conditional in-process dispatch paths: recording requests use the record-store implementation, while supported init requests use installation. The arrows do not prescribe sequence or imply that both paths run for every invocation.; IF-004 remains owned by MOD-018 and IF-006 by MOD-019. MOD-010 and MOD-014 implement their assigned behavior; execution co-location does not transfer contract ownership or make logical Modules separate services.; The entrypoint uses JavaScript ES modules and direct calls/imports. This source mapping supplies no measured execution, minimum Node version, agent-host runtime, or all-platform qualification.
Scoped public command execution (IF-004); entry contract declared for this execution context
